name: debugbundle
description: Investigate production incidents and aggregate product analytics with read-only DebugBundle evidence.

interface.shortDescription: Investigate incidents and aggregate product analytics.
interface.longDescription: Connect DebugBundle to inspect authorized production incidents, deterministic redacted bundles, reproductions, runtime improvements, aggregate product analytics, and endpoint-health evidence. Version 1 is read-only and cannot modify projects, incident state, analytics settings, or customer data.
defaultPrompt: Explain this incident from its bundle and reproduction.
Summarize product usage and checkout funnel performance for the last 7 days.
Why is this endpoint health check failing?
